data.gender_notes: Ravi is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Sanskrit, Ravi comes from the word ‘Ravi’, which means ‘Sun God’. The name is derived from the god Ravi, who is considered the god of the sun in Hindu mythology. In Hindu culture, the sun is a symbol of energy, strength, and life, making Ravi a powerful and auspicious name for a baby boy. The name Ravi carries the meaning “Sun God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ravi usually hope their child will grow to embody sun god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Ravi belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sun God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ravi total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
